notes.title: Dev update - 12/08/2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone!



We are pleased to announce that we have already implemented these two important features:

Steam cloud save: you will be able to use the steam cloud save feature, so you will synchronise your save with the cloud!

Steam achievements: are you ready to try to get all the achievements?



See you all in the Swamp!



GunginStudio
